topic: Gojo was sealed by a one minute loophole inside his own head, not by a stronger sorcerer
title: Gojo's Sealing Needed Only One Minute Of Memories
description: Gojo's defeat in Shibuya was a loophole: the sealing cube only needed one minute to pass inside his brain. Here is how Geto's face did what no technique could.
comment: Was Gojo's sealing his own fault for being too trusting, or a perfect plan he couldn't have stopped?

lines.text: Gojo wasn't sealed by someone stronger. He was sealed by one minute of memories.

shot.fallback: a blindfold-free white haired man staring at a stranger in a subway

lines.text: Shibuya station, chapter 89. Gojo opens Unlimited Void for just 0.2 seconds.

shot.fallback: a flash of cosmic light filling a subway platform

lines.text: That freezes everyone on Platform B5F.

shot.fallback: frozen monsters in a glowing white space

lines.text: Then he spends 299 seconds clearing every transfigured human off it.

shot.fallback: a fast white haired fighter in a subway

lines.text: And right after, a man in Geto's face just walks out into the open.

shot.fallback: a robed man stepping toward a tired sorcerer

lines.text: The sealing cube needs Gojo within four meters for one full minute.

shot.fallback: a small ornate cube floating in a hand

lines.text: But the wiki says that minute only has to pass inside his brain.

shot.fallback: a man stunned by a familiar face

lines.text: So the fake Geto just lets him look, and the memories do the rest.

shot.fallback: two young students laughing, shown as a faded memory

lines.text: Gojo knows it's an imposter. The minute still runs.

shot.fallback: a shocked man staring at a stranger wearing a friend's face

lines.text: Here's my read: grief was the loophole, and no technique could have blocked it.

shot.fallback: a lonely man looking at an old photograph

lines.text: So where was Yuta Okkotsu while that minute ran?

shot.fallback: a young swordsman training far from home

lines.text: Because Gojo wasn't sealed by someone stronger, he was sealed by one minute of memories...

shot.fallback: a sealed black cube in a dark station

self_check.hook: Contrarian claim naming Gojo in the first sentence
self_check.loop: Last line restates the hook claim and flows into line 1
